title.value: Extract receipts into a CSV and audit subscriptions with Claude Code

introduction.value: The author tested Claude Code on non-coding jobs: pulling vendor, date, amount and category from about 120 scanned receipts into a CSV, and subscription auditing and a corrupted video; a few tasks only half worked.

method.value: The author scanned about 120 receipts into a folder and asked Claude Code to pull vendor, date, amount and category into one CSV. It read each PDF and flagged receipts over the documentation-retention threshold. For subscriptions, it analyzed two years of bank statements exported as CSVs and grouped recurring charges by merchant.

outcome.value: Receipts came out as a CSV, with a handful of faded thermal receipts left blank rather than guessed. The subscription audit surfaced an unused gym membership. The author estimates about 90% time saved on receipts.

notes.value: Faded receipts came back with blank amounts, so check those by hand. Spot-check totals before filing anything. All tests ran on the $20/month Claude Pro plan.

source_text.body:
Extract receipts into a CSV and audit subscriptions with Claude Code
The author tested Claude Code on non-coding jobs: pulling vendor, date, amount and category from about 120 scanned receipts into a CSV, and subscription auditing and a corrupted video; a few tasks only half worked.
Done with
CC
Claude Code
What they did
The author scanned about 120 receipts into a folder and asked Claude Code to pull vendor, date, amount and category into one CSV. It read each PDF and flagged receipts over the documentation-retention threshold. For subscriptions, it analyzed two years of bank statements exported as CSVs and grouped recurring charges by merchant.
How it went
Receipts came out as a CSV, with a handful of faded thermal receipts left blank rather than guessed. The subscription audit surfaced an unused gym membership. The author estimates about 90% time saved on receipts.
Worth knowing
Faded receipts came back with blank amounts, so check those by hand. Spot-check totals before filing anything. All tests ran on the $20/month Claude Pro plan.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
Copy prompt
Look at the folder [path to scanned receipts] and read each receipt to extract vendor, date, amount, currency and a spending category into a single CSV called receipts.csv. Flag any receipt you could not read confidently in a separate list rather than guessing. When done, give me the row count and total, and don't move, rename or delete any of my original files.
Original source: https://websites2know.com/claude-code-use-cases/
